agents_doc:
AGENTS
• Prey — a count with logistic reproduction (prob prey_reproduce/step, capped at prey_capacity).
• Predator — an individual with an energy store. Each step it loses 'metabolism' energy; with probability 1−e^(−hunt_rate·prey) it catches a prey and gains 'energy_gain'; if energy ≥ repro_threshold it splits into two; if energy ≤ 0 it dies.

Aggregate series (prey, predators) are measured each step, not assumed.

model.description: Individual-based 'wolf–sheep' predation. Prey reproduce (logistically capped); each predator burns energy, hunts prey (energy gain), reproduces when well-fed, and starves when not. Counts oscillate like Lotka–Volterra but are stochastic — change the seed and watch a different history, including extinctions the smooth ODE never shows.
model.title: Predator–prey (agent-based)
